newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's brewery starts making Stella Artois.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's brewery starts making Stella Artois.

text.p: Croatia's leading brewery, Zagrebacka Pivovara, in which Belgium's Interbrew owns a controlling package, begun production of "Stella Artois" beer for domestic market, a company official said on Friday.
The brewery is planning to offer Croatian beer lovers some 25,000 hectolitres of Stella by the end of the year, deputy chief executive in charge of procurement Jadranka Gotic told Reuters.
Interbrew, which controls a 58-percent stake in Zagrebacka Pivovara, has provided the licence, technology and raw material for the production.
It will also vouch for the quality of their leading brand produced in Croatia, Gotic said.
The share of Stella in Zagrebacka's total annual output of 1.1 million hectolitres is a little over two percent.
Interbrew, which bought into the Croatian brewery in 1994, then set an ambitious plan of expanding its market share from 28 to 38 percent by 1999.
